state.target_treatment: DC-voltage calibration of the same Fluke 5700A multifunction calibrator at a common setting s, with the shared INRIM 10 V reference-standard contribution.
state.scope: Sections III-V's INRIM-Lab / Cal-Lab interlaboratory comparison. Restrict the dependence judgment to the DC-voltage traceability term in Equation 5; do not generalize it to all uncertainty components or electrical quantities.

evidence.text: The comparison uses verification without adjustment. The Cal-Lab traceability chain shares standards calibrated at INRIM with the INRIM-Lab chain, creating partial correlation. For DC voltage, Equation 5 identifies the INRIM calibration uncertainty of the 10 V standard in both chains.

evidence.location: Section V, PDF p. 3, Equations 1-5; Conclusions, PDF p. 6
evidence.text: Cal-Lab measures before and after INRIM-Lab. Its two values at the same setting s are averaged to reduce possible calibrator drift in the comparison. The difference uncertainty includes a covariance term: u(d)^2 = u(E_L)^2 + u(E_I)^2 - 2 r u(E_L)u(E_I). Equation 5 gives r = u_B(std_DCV)^2/[u(E_I)u(E_L)]. The authors report high instrument stability.
